Name: Fall Colors and gradual seasonal foliage changes
Author: inmognito
Description:
Tree colors are more varied and change gradually as the seasons change. 

Uses Alternative Textures and Content Patcher.

[b][size=5]Now with a more muted version that blends in with [/size][size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]GrapePontas's Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url][/size][size=5]﻿

Instructions:[/size]
[/b][list=1]
[*]Unzip and place in your Mods folder
[*]Start up Stardew Valley
[*]If using Vibrant Pastoral recolour, open the config file (Or the mod options if  you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ installed) and change from 'Vanilla' to 'VPR'. Note that changes will not be seen until the next in-game day.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Will override most recolours and foliage replacements
[*]Not compatible with the Longer Seasons mod.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Limitations
[/b][/size][list]
[*]Only affects trees planted (or farms started) after the mod is installed
[*]Affects roughly 90% of trees, leaves one or two in the original colourscheme
[*]Static Pines, Oaks and Maples will change colour in line with choppable trees but will all be the same colour as one another.

[/list]
